{{Top|leg}}
A '''zone''' was a level of territorial organization within the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Territory Administration]], directly below the level of [[region]]. Each zone was controlled by a [[Zone Director]], and there were typically fifty zones per region. A zone generally consisted of a few dozen [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], and had a [[Security Division]] [[Sub-Precinct]] assigned to it.
